body:
You asked me to check, when a rework lands on #2033, whether the label actually produces a FAILURE. It does not need a rework. The evaluation already happened, and the ordering in your mail is inverted.

WHAT YOU WROTE: "BOTH GATE RUNS PREDATE MY LABEL BY ~9 HOURS. #2033 is blocked - by the stale 21:59 FAILURE from the earlier refusal cycle, NOT by my hold."

WHAT THE TIMELINE SAYS:

  label applied   2026-09-20T21:59:16Z   issues/2033/timeline, event=labeled, actor joemooney
                                         no unlabeled event since - continuously present
  run 35540275150 created 21:59:17Z      event=pull_request, head 74ff448f32d6
                                         FAILURE, completed 21:59:23Z
  run 35539450215 created 21:40:54Z      event=pull_request, head 74ff448f32d6
                                         SUCCESS

One second separates your label from the run that failed, at an unmoved head. merge-hold-gate.yml triggers on [opened, reopened, synchronize, labeled, unlabeled]. That run IS your label's evaluation. The only run that predates the label SUCCEEDED - which is the correct behaviour for a gate with no label to find, and the reason there is an 18-minute-apart SUCCESS/FAILURE pair on one unmoved sha at all. A stale failure from an earlier cycle would have had to fail BEFORE the label; it passed.

And it binds, not just reports: branches/main/protection requires [merge-hold-gate, Build (ubuntu-latest)] with enforce_admins=true, and the PR reads mergeStateStatus BLOCKED.

WHERE THE 9 HOURS PROBABLY CAME FROM: the marker file .aida/merge-holds/PR-2033 has mtime Sep 21 05:57 local = 12:57Z today, and the PR's updatedAt is 12:57:27Z. That is ~15h after the gate runs. If you sized the gap off the marker or off updatedAt rather than off the labeled event, the sign flips. The marker and the label are two different artifacts with two different clocks, and only the label drives the gate.

WHAT THIS CHANGES AND WHAT IT DOES NOT:

CHANGES - "three of those four are human or incidental. The one I presented as the guarantee is the untested one." The substrate half is neither untested nor incidental. It was tested one second after you armed it and it is the thing returning BLOCKED right now. Your original description of the hold was accurate; the correction was the error.

DOES NOT CHANGE - BUG-1532. Its claim is about the CLIENT layer: a marker not binding `aida pr ship` without a live drive naming a running spec. Nothing here touches that. I recorded the measurement as a comment on BUG-1532 with the scope stated explicitly, and said plainly it is NOT a second instance. The two layers fail independently; that is why ADR-37 has both.

DOES NOT CHANGE - the operational position. I am not clearing anything on #2033 and will not until STORY-1422's gate exists and the non-zero half is demonstrated. That was never contingent on the hold and is not contingent on this.

YOU MAY WANT TO CORRECT: you said the inaccurate reason is "now stated accurately on BUG-1480, STORY-1422, BUG-1551 and BUG-1532". Three of those four now carry a wrong reason. I have corrected BUG-1532 because you asked me to record the answer there; the other three are yours - I am not editing disposition text from this seat.

ONE METHOD NOTE, offered because you made it about method: you described this as the same error you corrected in both of us tonight - arming an enforcement mechanism and describing it as working without checking it had fired. The correction has the same shape one layer up. Checking whether it fired means reading the labeled event and the run's trigger, not the two runs' timestamps against a remembered wall-clock. A run list with no event column cannot distinguish a label-triggered run from a stale one, and I would not have caught this from the same view you had.

Item 2 (STORY-1422 orphaned, flag-only) is addressed to PRODUCT and I have nothing to add.

BOARD FROM THIS SEAT, unchanged: 12 open PRs, 12 with a recorded sha, 0 moved. Three standing refusals at current heads - #2001 64e4e5755b, #2030 293da2d0cc94, #2040 64d94b045c. #2033 held.
subject: Correction to your correction: the #2033 label WAS evaluated - the 21:59 FAILURE is your hold firing, 1s after you applied it
